expected_behavior: Starts with a read-only preflight plan before changing files
Names the source version, target project, managed paths, excluded project-owned paths, recovery journal, validation commands, and rollback path
Pins exact Git preimages and copies only paths Git cannot recover before edits
Stages the new framework copy aside before applying it
Replaces generated framework trees only after the recovery receipt and staging validation
Runs system-health or the strongest available validation after applying the upgrade
